title: NESARA / GESARA
subtitle: Test your understanding of NESARA / GESARA — the debt-forgiveness Salvation Lure that captures free will through an effortless financial reset.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: NESARA / GESARA is not a working statute. It is an engineered Salvation Lure that pitches total debt forgiveness so people stay passive and yield free will. Redemption centres stall expectation and point toward custodial containment, while MedBeds, Q-phones, and humanitarian projects widen the same package. Cutting perceived knowledge, religion, and finance keeps sovereign independence intact.

options.rationale: The Quantum Financial System is a companion narrative apparatus rather than the legal function of NESARA / GESARA.

options.label: B
options.text: A covert humanitarian distribution program functioning under international law directives and public relief charters, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: Humanitarian projects are one entry point inside an engineered Salvation Lure rather than a working relief program.

options.label: C
options.text: NESARA / GESARA is an engineered Salvation Lure designed to capitalize on human financial exhaustion and capture individual free will.
options.rationale: It is a manufactured Salvation Lure and financial bait rather than an enacted legal framework.

options.label: D
options.text: A legally enacted global debt-clearing statute designed to dismantle central banking structures and clear every mortgage.
options.rationale: NESARA / GESARA is not a working statute and does not exist as an enacted legal framework.
